text:
FINDING ON MY OWN LANDED WORK, measured not argued. Reserved cost.scala under rv-01M17N8HH49AH9NQTK2MV4CS0T.

THE PREDICATE IS WRITTEN AGAINST THE WRONG FUNCTION. In cost(), the Chart term comes from
ChartDistance.reduction(unit, node, view), which measures over view.structuralMembers(node.ref) -
the LEAVES under the node. But chartEligible tests node.evidence.nonEmpty - the node's OWN chart.
Those coincide for a leaf and diverge for a segment. StorySourceView is explicit that they must:
  case NarrativeNodeId.Segment(_) => None // segments never get a fabricated chart
So every segment node has evidence None while its leaves carry the charts actually measured.

The comment at the site justifies the predicate by citing ChartDistance.report at cost.scala:346-348.
report(unit, node) takes no view and does need both own-charts, so the comment is true OF REPORT.
The code calls reduction. The justification is sound for a function that is not the one running.
(The line numbers are stale too - 346-348 is Names.overlap now.)

RUNNABLE PROBE, segment sc2 with charted leaf e4, unit with evidence:
  segment isLeaf=false ownEvidence=false, members charted=1
  chart estimate = Observed(0.0)        <- Chart IS measured
  terms = Semantic, Propositional, Entity, Granularity, Distortion, CHART
  supportWeight = 1.0                   <- claims nothing was assumed
  wChart=0.5, wSensory=0.15
  scaleToEligible now   = 0.9054        <- cost multiplied DOWN
  scaleToEligible fixed = 1.0405
  supportOf fixed       = 0.9610

TWO ERRORS, COMPOUND. Chart is present but not eligible, so wPresent > wEligible:
1. the blend DISCOUNTS the cell by 9.5%; against the correct scaling it is priced 14.9% too low
   (1.0405/0.9054). A cell is made to look better BECAUSE it measured more.
2. supportOf clamps with math.min(1.0, ...), so the ratio above one reports as 1.0 - full support -
   when the honest figure is 0.961. Sensory was in fact assumed and the carrier says it was not.

WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND BOOKKEEPING. The discount lands only on segment cells, and only when charts
exist. It is a systematic thumb on the scale for COARSE anchors over leaf anchors - it would make
recall look more scene-level and gist-like than it is, which is one of the things this system exists
to measure. WOG has no charts, which is why all 202 align tests pass over it. This turns on exactly
when the embed-grakern structural channel goes live.

WHICH SIDE IS WRONG: the predicate, not the measurement. Segments have a DECLARED chart estimand
over members - that is what structuralMembers, segmentEvidence and StructuralReductionSuite are for.
Proposed fix, which coincides on leaves so no leaf expectation can move:
  unit.evidence.nonEmpty && view.structuralMembers(node.ref).exists(_.hasEvidence)
leavesUnder(ref) returns the node itself for a leaf, so this is a strict generalization.
It also gets the contradiction case right: if every charted member is contradicted the term is
Missing while eligibility stays true, which is a genuine missed measurement and should lower support.
That is already how Structural behaves; Chart was the odd one out.

Note Structural is NOT affected: structuralEligible never required node.evidence.

Building the law now. It has to fail on current code before I touch the predicate.
